title: Unraveling the reaction dynamics mechanism and thermodynamic pathway of lead iodide and organic cations in the two-step sequential deposition process
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01294E, Review Article
Jiacheng He, Wangping Sheng, Kaikai Liu, Qianqian Cai, Yang Zhong, Licheng Tan, Yiwang Chen
We summarize the developments in the two-step process and provide strategies for its advancement from reaction kinetics and thermodynamics perspectives while extending the discussion towards impending future challenges and proposing directions.
